If I’m at TechEd, I’ll be at the Party.

You won’t find an IHOP in Boston… as crazy as it sounds, its actually pretty difficult to find an all-night eatery within the city. There was one little breakfast place on Cambridge St near Mass General Hospital that I can remember being open at odd hours.
It will probably be pretty difficult to find a “private room” at a restaurant without shelling out some cash – Boston is very different than the typical TechEd convention cities, there isn’t a lot of space to go around. We might want to just go for one of the open air bar/restaurants in Faneuil Hall, or nearby on the water (can’t remember any names).
